headline: The Scholarship Roadmap
subheadline: Consultation for Musicians at a Crossroads
description: The Scholarship Roadmap was a mentorship program helping student musicians navigate the path to a music career. While the program is no longer active, Trevor accepts a limited number of consultations for musicians at a crossroads — whether you're a high school or college student exploring your options, or a working professional seeking a fresh perspective on your path.

whatToExpect.title: Career Mapping
whatToExpect.body: A frank conversation about what a professional music career actually looks like — the multiple income streams, the trade-offs, and the skills that matter most in today's market.

whatToExpect.title: School & Scholarship Strategy
whatToExpect.body: Guidance on selecting programs, building an audition portfolio, and navigating the financial aid landscape for music students.

whatToExpect.title: The Working Professional
whatToExpect.body: For musicians already in the industry, a second perspective on pivoting, expanding your work, or re-evaluating what success means at this stage.

availability: Trevor accepts a limited number of consultations per quarter.
